item.title: CISA Red Team Compromised Two Critical Infrastructure Orgs, One Detected Nothing
item.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has published the results of two red team assessments it conducted simultaneously against two critical infrastructure organizations, using what it described as similar tradecraft while recording sharply different defensive outcomes.
